sections.title: PART 1: Piping — Line Reference Data (use a continuation sheet if more than one P&ID / ISO)
sections._note:
This is the same four-part pressure test report as `plumbing-pressure-test.json` (PPT) and `acmv-pipe-pressure-test.json` (APT), issued for fire protection hose reel pipework. Diffed against the plumbing source: the parts, fields and wording match; only the sheet title, the discipline and the code differ. Kept as its own template rather than widening PPT — a template carries one discipline, and the repo already runs near-identical siblings this way (`chwfcu-air-balancing` / `dxfcu-air-balancing`). If any of the three forms is revised, revise the others.

Like PPT and unlike APT, this sheet has an unlabelled note box beside Line No, carried as `line_note` — it is filled with free text like "See attached highlighted areas."

sections.title: PART 2: Pressure Gauge & Chart Recorder Data
sections._note: One section per paper Part. Rows rather than a field group because the two certificate questions are three-state controls, which a field group cannot render; the `group` labels also disambiguate the repeated Calibration Date / Expiry Date rows. Not wired to the app's calibration register — the sheet records one fixed gauge and one fixed chart recorder rather than a table of instruments, so no `instruments` block is declared. Same call as PPT and APT.

rows._note: Both certificate rows carry a remarks cell because N/A requires a remark (SPEC §5) — and N/A is the routine answer here when no chart recorder is used.

sections.title: PART 3: Test Data
sections._note:
Type of Test and Test Medium are `status` rows with `neutral` outcomes — they classify the test, they do not pass or fail it, so they must not reach the outstanding-items list. Each keeps its own "Other — please state" text row, as on the sheet. Pressures and temperatures stay text, not number: the sheet is filled with the unit inline ("185 psi") and with "NA".

The break follows APT, whose rows and heights these are: measured with every field filled, Parts 1–2 come to 213.6mm of a 245mm body, Part 3 to 214.6mm, and Part 4 to 106.8mm on the page PrintView gives the footer — Part 3 and Part 4 together measured 321.4mm, 76mm over, which is why the sign-off is the footer rather than an in-flow section.

rows.description: Other type of test — please state

rows._note: Photos attach to the finishing pressure — the gauge photo is the evidence a witness looks for. The print row appears only when photos exist, so a record without them matches the source page.

rows.description: Remarks / Exceptions — attach test certificates, calibration reports etc. as necessary to this report

footer.title: PART 4: Test result witnessed and certified as satisfactory. Pipeline(s) to be drained and re-instated for pre-commissioning.
